{{Top|leg}}
The '''Core Dome''' was one of the large spherical modules of the [[Kuat Passenger Port]]. It was responsible for dealing with flights originating from, and heading towards, the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. All craft docking at the Core Dome require transit permits allowing them access to the Core Worlds.
